_comment: Per-person ROUND-TRIP ground cost (EUR) from home (Zagreb centre) to each departure airport, cheapest realistic public transport, booked ~5 weeks ahead, mid-week. Source: research/04-home-region.md §7 (FlixBus API prices 2026-10-04). quotes.py: uses 'eur' (+ a numeric 'hotel' if set, counted once before the outbound flight; one-way rows get half of 'eur'). 'hotel_if' and 'fri_eur' are NOTES only: quotes.py warns about 'hotel_if' on add, so pass the night with --extras and Friday/Sunday prices with --ground. Origins missing here get a conservative default shown as '?' (pass --ground). Virtual-origin values (MXP, BGY, FCO, WAW, IST, HEL, ARN, BRU, STN, LHR) are placeholders: override with real positioning fares. Times/prices vary by date: run scripts/flixbus_ground.py --date for each finalist. A different home base: quotes.py ground-init --trip <trip> (per-trip file); never overwrite this shared one.

VCE.hotel_if: dep before ~15:30 -> 18:00 bus + airport night, or +60 hotel

VIE.how: FlixBus direct airport 06:30, or 01:45/23:30 night bus

BUD.how: FlixBus (+ bus 100E). Nov 2026: 5.3 h direct, Fri 23:59 direct to airport. May 2027 (checked by dry run): NO direct bus, 8.5-12 h transfers, so hotel night needed for a midday flight. Also check the ZAG-BUD train (hzpp.hr / mavcsoport.hu).
BUD.hotel_if: morning/midday dep (no same-day arrival on many dates, e.g. 12 May 2027) -> +50

MUC.how: FlixBus night 22:30 or EN Lisinski night train + S-Bahn (90-130)

MXP.how: Ryanair ZAG-BGY (20-60 + bag) + bus BGY->MXP; separate ticket -> buffer night

WAW.how: LOT ZAG-WAW or Ryanair ZAG-WMI + transfer

BRU.how: Ryanair ZAG-CRL + bus, or Croatia Airlines ZAG-BRU

_positioning_note: For virtual origins reached by a positioning flight, replace 'eur' with the ACTUAL positioning fare found (Azair/Ryanair/Wizz) x2 + transfers, and add a buffer night (+50-80) for separate tickets.
